children: U.S. oil and gas producer's fiscal Q4 revenue rose 15% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q4 more than doubled sequentially but missed analyst estimates
Subsequent to quarter-end, company completed $16 mln Permian Basin mineral and royalty acquisition
Company expects fiscal 2027 to benefit from new production across multiple assets
Company says ongoing operator activity in key basins to provide continued development visibility
HIGHER PRICES - The increase in revenue yr/yr was driven primarily by a 20% increase in average realized equivalent prices, partially offset by a 4% decrease in average daily production
PRODUCTION INCREASES - Q4 production rose 3% quarter-over-quarter, with new wells and acquisitions contributing to output
DERIVATIVE LOSSES - Adjusted EBITDA was lower than prior-year quarter due to realized losses on derivative contracts
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas exploration and production peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Evolution Petroleum Corp is $4.75, about 28% above its September 14 closing price of $3.71
The stock recently traded at 158 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 162 three months ago
